items.title: Tom McIntosh — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: He says America is a much better place because of my creativity. He says, “Laura and I would hope that you would share your creativity with the world.” That’s what I want to do. I hope that you guys will help me with that. So, I thank you and I sense nothing but sincerity and honesty in this whole approach. It’s been an excellent experience for me.
Good. ### END OF INTERVIEW Transcribed by Kyle Kelly-Yahner
